description: Issue #837 (maintainer ruling #833): with `interaction-events` active, BINDING the profile block-heads `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click` is accepted. spec/grammar.md:388 makes every binding form accept any name -- a keyword, a primitive, or an alias spelling of one -- as a normative MUST, so all four surface forms here (assignment's colon-place, its bare-place spelling, a `for ... in` binder, and `local`) check clean. Paired with bindings-free-core-only, which runs the BYTE-IDENTICAL source under Core Language alone: the two profile sets differ by exactly `interaction-events` -- Interaction depends only on Core (`PROFILE_DEPS` in scripts/harness/index.mjs, spec/conformance.md), so no third profile is present to confound the comparison -- and both are clean, which is what proves binding freedom is profile-INDEPENDENT rather than merely permitted. It mirrors the Sprites pair reserved-bindings-with-sprites / -without-sprites. DECLARING the same four raises -- see block-heads-reserved-under-profile, which uses the `define` declaration slot. `"check": true` -- nothing is executed and no events are produced.
